events.description: In spring 2020 C gave A.B. a letter saying she was struggling with gender identity and was non-binary
events.quote: In the spring of 2020, C gave me a letter

events.description: Policy 713 took effect in the version then in force
C began seeing a psychologist with expertise in transgender youth in fall 2020, who advised following C's lead on names and pronouns
events.quote: C began to see this psychologist in the fall of 2020.

events.description: In spring 2021 C came out at school as a transgender boy using a new name and he/him pronouns
events.quote: In the spring of 2021, C told me about "coming out" at school as a boy.

events.description: A classmate's mother told A.B. that teachers and staff were using C's new name and pronouns
events.quote: the mother of one of C's classmates told me

events.description: The school's vice-principal phoned A.B., said the school was 'following the policy', and hung up when she became upset
events.quote: I received a phone call from the school's vice-principal

events.description: After the call A.B. found Policy 713 online
events.quote: After the phone call, I googled "New Brunswick schools" and "transgender students."

events.description: The psychologist's September 2021 email said supports such as binders and period suppression were what C needed
events.quote: The psychologist told me in an email from September 2021

events.description: In spring 2022 the psychologist reported C wanted testosterone but said it was too early
events.quote: In the spring of 2022, the psychologist contacted me

events.description: At the Fall 2022 Meeting the psychologist recommended starting testosterone at age 14
events.quote: In the fall of 2022, the psychologist wrote to me again and requested a meeting

events.description: The family doctor referred C to a pediatrician for hormone therapy
events.quote: our family doctor made a referral to a pediatrician

events.description: C had two pediatrician appointments; A.B. brought research articles; the pediatrician prescribed testosterone
events.quote: Chad two appointments with the pediatrician in 2023.

events.description: C began testosterone in summer/fall 2023; A.B. signed the authorization
events.quote: C began taking testosterone in the summer/fall of 2023.

events.description: The psychologist recommended a bilateral mastectomy for C as soon as possible
events.quote: The next step of gender transition that C requested was a bilateral mastectomy.

events.description: A.B. swore the affidavit at Island View, New Brunswick
events.quote: I swear this affidavit bona.fide for no improper purpose.
